title: Plum Sorbet
changes_from_base: Plums cooked briefly in their skins for colour replace the mango and lime; less corn syrup.
summary: Ripe plums cooked briefly in their skins give this sorbet a deep pink colour and a rich, sweet-sharp flavour.

ingredients.item: ripe red or dark plums, stoned and quartered
light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Soften
steps.text: Put the plums, skins and all, in the pan with the water and sugar, cover and cook gently for 8-10 min, until the fruit collapses and the juice turns deep pink.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend with the corn syrup and salt until smooth, then press through the sieve to catch any tough skin.

steps.title: Taste
steps.text: Very sweet plums may need a little lemon juice; add it a few drops at a time.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and chill for at least 3 h.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn for 20-25 min, then freeze for at least 3 h. Soften for 10 min before scooping.

tips: Dark-skinned plums give the most vivid colour.
Taste before adding lemon; tart plums may not need any.
Serve with a dollop of thick yoghurt or a crisp biscuit.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
